use_cases: Cards, headings, social images, short passages, and playful interface copy at 20–72 px
audiences: Readers of Taiwan Traditional Chinese, Latin text, Bopomofo, and Japanese kana
personality: playful, warm, observant, and clearly handwritten
non_goals: Mascot dingbats, literal cats inside every glyph, detached cat hats, brush calligraphy, random spikes, or a tail terminal that changes character identity
example_text: 貓耳手札：今天也要把字寫清楚。
注音ㄅㄆㄇ，かなあいう，カナアイウ，αβΩ。

design_contract.stroke_model: Upright rounded gel-pen handwriting with 62–88 unit median strokes, low contrast, one restrained cat-tail terminal attached to an existing final stroke where identity permits, and neutral safety forms where decoration would alter topology

sources.authority: Hash-pinned collection contract: 6,060 Han plus the existing 3,060-codepoint project non-Han repertoire

repertoire.semantic_empty_policy: Only the 17 contourless spacing and control scalars declared by the pinned nonhan-3060 repertoire may be encoded without visible outlines
unencoded_alternates: Exactly 93 hash-pinned vertical alternates admitted only through vert and vrt2

references.description: Taiwan Ministry of Education standard character forms and repository identity copybooks
references.license: Public identity reference and project-authored copybook metadata; no outline rights are exercised

references.description: The frozen Mew Note TC cat-tail pilot rasters after their style direction was accepted
